qc.label_under_test: ' press' and ' news' used as the journalism modifier of an event or item (press conference, news conference, press release), and French 'conf' in conférence: the media-briefing word, as opposed to journalism contexts without those words and 'press' as a machine or verb

neighbours.label: ' press' and ' news' used as the journalism modifier of an event or item (press conference, news conference, press release), and French 'conf' in conférence: the media-briefing word, as opposed to journalism contexts without those words and 'press' as a machine or verb
fire: The coach held a brief press conference after the game.
The mayor spoke at a news conference on Tuesday.
The airline put out a press release this morning.
Reporters crowded into the news briefing at city hall.
Le ministre a parlé lors d'une conférence à Genève.
La délégation a salué le texte de la Conférence de Rome.
She read it out at her first press briefing.
He answered questions at the evening news conference.
quiet: The coach held a brief team meeting after the game.
The mayor spoke at a town meeting on Tuesday.
The airline put out a delay notice this morning.
Reporters crowded into the hallway at city hall.
Le ministre a parlé lors d'une réunion à Genève.
La délégation a salué le texte de la lettre de Rome.
Please press the green button at the first door.
He heard the bad news at the evening meal.

notes: QC confirm, no probing. Fire covers ' press' and ' news' as modifiers and French 'conférence'. Near misses keep the news setting with other nouns, ' press' as a verb and 'news' as a plain noun.
